annotations.title: French condominiums whose syndic mandate ends soon (by area)

description: Use this when you need to know which French condominiums in an area have a syndic mandate ending soon. One call returns up to 100 condominiums for a commune (INSEE code), postal code, department or a syndic's SIRET and a date window (default next 6 months), sorted by mandate end date, with current professional syndic, lots and address, from the official ANAH registry. Prospect list for property managers, insurers, contractors. Price: 0.03 USDC per call (x402).

avant.description: Window end, default today + 180 days (window of 2 years at most)

name: syndic_echeances

duree_declaree_suspecte.description: End date more than 3 years (and a month) after the record's last update: a suspicion, not proof of an irregularity

jours_avant_fin_mandat.description: Days until the declared end date, 0 on that day, null once passed

jours_depuis_fin_mandat.description: Days since the declared end date, null until it has passed

statut.description: Reading of the record at date_calcul; echeance_dans_90_jours covers day 0 to day 90 included

type_syndic.description: professionnel, bénévole (cooperative syndicates included, as in the registry), or non déclaré
